title: Nap Behavior
description: Allows mobs to occassionally stop and take a nap under certain conditions.

cooldown_max.title: Cooldown Max
cooldown_max.description:
Maximum time in seconds the mob has to wait before using the goal again

Sample values:
• fox: 7

cooldown_min.title: Cooldown Min
cooldown_min.description:
Minimum time in seconds the mob has to wait before using the goal again

Sample values:
• fox: 2

mob_detect_dist.title: Mob Detect Dist
mob_detect_dist.description:
The block distance in x and z that will be checked for mobs that this mob detects

Sample values:
• fox: 12

mob_detect_height.title: Mob Detect Height
mob_detect_height.description:
The block distance in y that will be checked for mobs that this mob detects

Sample values:
• fox: 6

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.
